summary.title: Invoice – Prince Upgrades & Support – YesLogic Pty Ltd
summary.long_summary: This document is an invoice issued by YesLogic Pty. Ltd., a company located at 7 / 39 Bouverie St, Carlton VIC 3053, Australia. The invoice is dated November 26, 2016, with the invoice number 161126 and a payment due date of 30 days after the invoice date. The customer details are placeholders for the recipient’s name, address, postcode, city, and country. The invoice item lists a single service: "Prince Upgrades & Support" covering the period from November 26, 2016 to November 26, 2017, priced at USD $950.00. The total amount due is also USD $950.00. Payment instructions are provided, directing the recipient to transfer the amount to Yes Logic Pty Ltd via Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA). The bank details include multiple BSB numbers (063010, 063019), the account number 13201652, SWIFT code CTBAAU2S, and the bank address at 231 Swanston St, Melbourne, VIC 3000, Australia. A note explains that Australian banks use BSB numbers instead of IBANs when transferring money to Australia. The invoice concludes with the company’s website www.yeslogic.com.
